单点势垒手算 · E=0，V=2 eV: Single-site barrier worked example · E=0, V=2 eV
在 N=2、K=0 时，c=(1,1)/√2 对 k=0 相长，对 k=π 相消: For N=2 and K=0, the components of c=(1,1)/√2 interfere constructively at k=0 and destructively at k=π, so W(0)=1 and W(π)=0. Changing the state to (1,−1)/√2 interchanges the weights while leaving the real-space probabilities unchanged. In the lab, keep N=2 and k/π=0, change the band index n from 0 to 1, and run again. Compare k/π=0 and −1 in the channel weights table. The first Brillouin zone lists −π, which is equivalent to π.
